steps.code:
# Get all songs from all playlists
playlist_song_ids = set()
for pl in playlists:
    pl_detail = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pl['playlist_id'], access_token=access_token)
    for song in pl_detail['songs']:
        playlist_song_ids.add(song['id'])
print(f"Total unique songs in playlists: {len(playlist_song_ids)}")

        playlist_song_ids.add(song['id'])
print(f"Total unique songs in playlists: {len(playlist_song_ids)}")

steps.code:
# Get genre for each liked song in playlists and count
from collections import Counter
genre_counts = Counter()
for song_id in liked_in_playlists:
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    genre = song['genre']
    genre_counts[genre] += 1
print(genre_counts)
